content: 1. The World Health Organization (WHO) has provided ethical guidance on tuberculosis prevention, care, and control, which was accessed on October 8, 2015. 2. A companion handbook to the WHO guidelines for managing drug-resistant tuberculosis programmatically was also accessed on October 8, 2015. 3.
